source: PatentsView Granted Patent Disambiguated Data (PVGPATDIS), data.uspto.gov
censoring_rationale: Filing years are shown only for the complete window 2005–2021: the corpus is a fixed grant-year window (2005–2025), so filing years before 2005 are left-censored and after 2021 right-censored (below 90% of median-year volume) and are excluded.
